integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot1] Original expressive stylized3D animated adult Brazilian street interview during a peaceful gamers protest, same warm red-brick electronics storefront and afternoon sunlight. Vertical768x1344, one stable eye-level medium-wide shot, no cuts, zoom or shake. Matte colorful clothes, grounded feet, expressive appealing adult faces, natural independent gestures. No real people, music, brands, subtitles or written words on buildings.
Adult black male reporter with short hair and navy jacket at screen-left, ONE black microphone; adult woman gamer with brown ponytail, silver round glasses and purple hoodie at screen-right. Different pair from the first interview. Two adults behind them hold EXACTLY TWO very large ivory blank paper placards high above their heads, one upper-left, one upper-right. Full rectangular surfaces and all corners always visible, upper margins24px, no waving, no text or symbols. Camera steady, front-facing flat paper for later exact graphic lettering. No other signs.
The audio contains ONLY the following TWO short Portuguese speech turns, performed naturally by the indicated person. The reporter asks ONE short question, then is silent for the rest of the interview; he must not add a second question. The woman replies ONCE with the entire quoted sentence. No narration, no improvised words, no extra utterance and no background voices. Keep the gap between the turns quiet.
1-3s: The reporter looks at her and asks just this: [Speech]Vai colocar mais memória?[EndSpeech] He then offers the microphone below her mouth, closes his mouth and LISTENS silently.
4.5-10s: She looks toward him and says just this ONE COMPLETE reply: [Speech]Só aumentou a parcela! A memória continua oito giga![EndSpeech] She gestures one open palm on parcela, then shrugs on oito giga. He listens with closed mouth. Both complete all words by11s.
11-15.08s: Only after she finishes, he gives a brief natural chuckle, and she smiles ruefully and lowers her hand. The crowd smiles but does not speak. Independent eyes, breathing and clothing movement continue normally through the final frame; no freeze or repeated gesture.
